notes: The v0.58 profile uses TSO as the architectural memory model, retained by v0.58.
The TSO contract applies to both scalar (BCC) and tile-memory (MTC/TMA) channels.
A single LXCPU must not reorder committed stores (including TSTORE beats) ahead of older stores.
Shader-kernel bridged accesses (`l.*.brg` and `v.*.brg`) participate in the same architectural TSO domain.

channel_contract.mtc: Tile memory channel (TLOAD/TSTORE and bridged MPAR/MSEQ shader-kernel flows)
channel_contract.rule: BCC and MTC operations participate in one TSO architectural ordering domain for a single LXCPU.

tso_axioms: Program-order store->store ordering is preserved for all addresses.
A younger load may read from memory before an older unrelated store becomes globally visible (store buffer behavior).
Store->load reordering is only visible as allowed by TSO; fence/aq/rl tighten ordering.
No operation may observe a younger store from the same LXCPU before an older store.

semantics: Every listed TMA operation is an architectural memory operation in the same TSO domain as scalar load/store.
TMA memory operations participate in aq/rl/fence ordering and must not violate store->store ordering.
A TMA memory operation may decompose into multiple internal beats and is architecturally non-atomic to external observers except for each individual MGATHER.CAS lane transaction.
Internal beats have implementation-defined issue order; software must not infer row or element beat order from one architectural operation.
Page and access faults are precise and restartable by software.
TPREFETCH performs the same reads, address translation, permission checks, faults, restart, beat decomposition, coherence, and ordering as TLOAD, but allocates and writes no destination tile state.
MGATHER and MGATHER.MASK form lane addresses from the base scalar and unsigned u16/u32/u64 offset-tile elements; masked-off lanes perform no memory access.
MSCATTER and MSCATTER.MASK use the same address formation and write the corresponding data-tile elements; masked-off lanes perform no memory access.
MGATHER.CAS atomically compares the addressed element with the expected tile element, conditionally writes the desired tile element, and returns the pre-CAS memory value for every active lane.

simt_lane_policy.rule: Inactive-lane behavior is explicit and deterministic; implementations must not mix merge/zero semantics within one architectural mode.

shader_kernel_domain.entry_boundary: acquire-style ordering point before kernel-side memory issue begins
shader_kernel_domain.exit_boundary: release-style ordering point before subsequent scalar blocks execute
shader_kernel_domain.bcc_scalar_memory: closed while a shader kernel is active

semantics: Orders memory operations of classes selected by pred_imm before operations selected by succ_imm in program order for the current LXCPU.
Under TSO, FENCE.D is required to order with device/MMIO domains and to create stronger cross-domain ordering points.
Ensures instruction fetch observes prior stores from the current LXCPU to memory that may be executed as code.
Defines the architectural boundary for self-modifying code and code generation.
